string.text: You feel watched.
Static on every channel. Something is coming.
Your PDA picks up a broken Monolith prayer. It is getting closer.
A voice under the static whispers your name.
The Zone has noticed you, %name%.
I can smell your fear, Stalker. Run while you still can.
The Zone is a small place. There is nowhere left to hide.
Did you think you were the predator here?
Your footsteps are like a beacon in the dark. I am coming.
You were lucky last time. Luck runs out in the Zone.
I remember how you fight, %name%. I have learned.
Again, Stalker. The Monolith does not forget.
How many times must I come for you, %name%?
Every wound you gave me made me stronger. Count them.
You are running out of places, %name%. I am not running out of patience.
%name%. The Monolith has whispered your name to me so many times.
There is no hunt left. Only the ending.
I have died for you a hundred times, %name%. Tonight it is your turn.
Enjoy this while it lasts. We are not finished.
Not today. But I will find you again.
You got lucky, Stalker. Remember my face.
The Monolith calls me back. This is not over.
You ran well. Next time you will not run far enough.
Your time is borrowed, Stalker. I will collect it.
Glory to the Monolith. Your road ends here, %name%.
The Monolith spoke your name. I came to answer.
You cannot hide from what lives in the static.
Kneel before the Monolith. It will be quick.
Every step you took led you here. The Zone is closing in.
Za Monolith! The Zone will drink your blood.
I walked through the Brain Scorcher to reach you. You will not outrun me.
The Monolith does not forgive. Neither do I.
The static is screaming. Something old is coming for you.
Every channel at once: a man's voice, praying to the Monolith.
Your PDA flickers a name you have never seen: %boss%. The signal is getting closer.
The Zone goes quiet. Even the anomalies are listening for him.
%boss% has fallen. His last coordinates come through on the Monolith channel: a stash.
The prayers on the channel stop. Someone sends coordinates instead: %boss%'s stash.
You slipped away this time. The Monolith keeps count.
Hide, then. I will be waiting in the static.
The Monolith calls me home. Do not mistake that for mercy.
I can hear your heartbeat.
You are walking the way I want you to.
Look around. You will not see me.
The static is me. It has always been me.
Closer than you think, %name%.
Your breath is so loud in the quiet.
%name%, you don't see me because I'm behind you right now.
Run, %name%. Every step brings you closer to me.
%name%. Close enough to hear you breathe.
You cannot outrun the Monolith, %name%.
New ground. Same prey.
The Monolith walks every road you walk, %name%.
Reloading, %name%?
Same place as last time, %name%. The Monolith remembers.
You fought us here before, %name%. We know this ground now.
Encrypted military traffic on your frequency. Your callsign is in it.
Your PDA pings a UNISG tracker. Someone is triangulating you.
Rotor noise far off, then silence. They are coming on foot.
Intercepted: 'Target is %faction%. Liquidate on sight.'
The Zone has noticed you, %name%. So has UNISG.
Target acquired. One of %faction%, alone. Moving in.
This is a cleanup operation. You are the mess.
Whatever is in your head will not stop a bullet.
You walked away last time. The file on you got thicker, %name%.
Second contact. We adjusted the approach.
%name%. Every report ends with your name. Today we close the file.
Command wants you gone. I want it personal.
%name%. Priority one. No withdrawal authorised.
This ends with you bagged and tagged.
Pulling out. This is not over.
Extraction. Mark this place, we will be back.
Fall back. We will finish this, %name%.
Operation window closed. You got lucky.
Recall order received. Next time, %name%.
We are pulled out. Your file stays open.
UNISG Command authorised your removal, %name%.
I have hunted things in the Zone that would eat %faction% whole.
No prayers on this channel. Only the countdown.
So, %faction%. I was trained to break things like you.
Rules of engagement: none.
The rest of %faction% is next. You are first.
Hold still. This will be clean.
I never miss twice, %name%.
Military channel: 'Specialist deployed, codename %boss%.' The signal is getting closer.
Your PDA locks up for a second. Someone very good has your position.
Every UNISG channel goes silent at once.
Operator %boss% KIA. His cache coordinates were on the squad net.
Military channel: '%boss% is down.' Then a set of coordinates: his cache.
Operation window closed. The file stays open.
Recalled. Do not get comfortable.
Command pulls me out. Next time there is no recall.
Thermals have you. Keep walking.
I can hear your heartbeat on the mic.
You will not see me. Nobody ever does.
Closer than you think, %name%.
Checking your six yet, %name%?
%name%. Don't turn around. I'm right behind you.
Keep running, %name%. You're only making this easier.
Close enough, %name%. Lights out.
Changing maps won't save you, %name%.
Target relocated. Pursuit continues.
You moved. So did we, %name%.
Reloading, %name%?
Same position as last time, %name%? Sloppy.
We mapped this spot last time, %name%. Predictable.

Army radio on your frequency. They are reading out your last position.
Your PDA catches a military net. The word 'cultist' comes up, then your name.
Helicopter blades in the distance, then nothing. A patrol is on foot now.
Intercepted: 'Target is %faction%. Engage on sight.'
The Zone has marked you, %name%. So has the Army.
Contact: one of %faction%, alone. Squad, move up.
Orders are simple. Find the cultist, end the cultist.
Your Monolith can't hear you out here.
You slipped away last time, %name%. The colonel wasn't happy.
Second sweep. We brought more men.
%name%. Your face is pinned to every board at the checkpoint.
This stopped being just orders a while ago.
%name%. Top of the list. Nobody goes home until you're down.
This ends with you in the back of a truck.
Pulling back. Mark the grid, we'll return.
Medevac! This isn't finished.
Fall back and regroup. We'll be back for you, %name%.
We're recalled to base. Count yourself lucky.
Command pulls us out. Next time, %name%.
Recall order. Your name stays on the list.
Command signed your death warrant, %name%. I'm delivering it.
I've cleared whole nests of %faction%. You're just one more.
The chaplain had nothing for you. Neither do I.
So, you're %faction%. The institute wants you in a bag.
Rules of engagement are suspended for you.
The rest of %faction% is next. You go first.
Stand still. A soldier's courtesy: it will be quick.
I don't need a second shot, %name%.
Army channel: 'Colonel %boss% has taken command of the hunt.' The signal is getting stronger.
Your PDA freezes. A military override has your coordinates.
Every army frequency goes quiet at once.
Colonel %boss% is down. His cache coordinates went out on the army net.
Army channel: '%boss% KIA.' Then a set of coordinates: his cache.
Recalled to base. This isn't over.
Command orders me out. Enjoy the quiet while it lasts.
I'm pulled out. Next time there is no recall.
Night vision has you. Keep walking.
I can count your steps from here.
You won't see me. Recon never gets seen.
Closer than you think, %name%.
Looking over your shoulder yet, %name%?
%name%. Don't move. I'm right behind you.
Run, %name%. Soldiers run longer.
That's close enough, %name%. Lights out.
A new map won't hide you, %name%.
Target moved. Pursuit continues.
You moved, %name%. So did the Army.
Reloading, %name%?
Same position as before, %name%? Careless.
We have this place on the map from last time, %name%.
